modifications.inspection_scope: Viewer installation of original HYDRA parts and Creality purchased hardware. Printed lower lip clearance and fan pilot registration are adaptations, not author CAD. Actual print strength and hardware tolerances require physical validation.

belted.author: KevinAkaSam
belted.version: Belted Z v3.7 / single motor / V-wheels · 6696a2f198f8

notices.belted: Single-motor Belted Z with V-wheels and F623 idlers. The PSU uses the author relocation holder. Printed seats are adapted to these native mating features. The 6 mm backing carries 2 mm pitch marks; tooth shape and tension are not simulated.
notices.klack: KlackEnder with the probe attached, gantry-mounted dock and fixed frame retainer. Native screw and T-nut seats are registered to this frame. The preview stops above the bed; probe pickup, calibration and homing are not simulated.
